notes:
ThunderAlley 3.13.0: new menus and startup
- New animated startup: a squad jumps from a helicopter at sunrise, free-falls and opens their parachutes while the game loads. The bar shows each real loading step, then sign in: Guest, Sign In or Create Account (or Tap to Start when signed in). Quick tools on the side: Updates, Notices, Support and Repair (safe graphics).
- New home hub: your soldier in the hangar, your rank, XP, Armory Keys and dog tags, Social / Notices / Music / Settings, a rotating event card, Challenges / Career / Profile tiles with live progress, and MODES · LOADOUT · VEHICLES · ARMORY. Pick Practice or Online, check your mode and map, then hit READY.
- Select Mode: Large Scale and Infantry tabs, the mode's picture and facts, View Maps (every map with its picture), Match Settings, mode cards and Confirm.
- Loadout: classes down the side, your soldier with the class's gear, every weapon and gear slot, perks and streaks, Rename and Equip.
- Armory: camos (per gun), charms and banners with their unlock missions and progress, and Equip.
- Operator: Career (prestige), Challenges (daily, weekly, assignments, weapon mastery) and Profile (banner, rank, account, stats) in one place.
- New-style pop-ups and a new results screen.
- Vehicle skins: coming soon.
- Fixed: a piece of the barrel could float above some guns with an optic plus attachments; the Mini Reflex sight is see-through; lasers sit low on the handguard.
- Browser version: phones get the touch layout and lighter graphics.
